descriptionChirho: To tear apart or split physically, used of the temple veil being torn, rocks splitting, heavens being rent open, nets tearing, and garments being torn (Matt 27:51; Mark 1:10, 15:38; Luke 5:36, 23:45; John 19:24, 21:11)
To be divided in opinion or faction; a metaphorical extension where a group of people is split into opposing parties (Acts 14:4, of the city being divided; Acts 23:7, of the assembly being divided)
